source='''def transform(grid):\n    """Shift all rows down one cell, filling the top row with the grid background."""\n    if not grid:\n        return []\n    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))\n    return [[background] * len(grid[0])] + [row[:] for row in grid[:-1]]\n'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'))
